items.html: *And if you say: ZA clothes the lower third of the Tifferet of Arich, and also the NHY within it — then how do we say that he was included only three within three? But the matter is that since the phase of the Tifferet is not a complete measure, but only one third, it does not count by name; and we mention only the NHY alone, which are complete measures, that were included in the HGT, and were three included in three.
